topics.topic: Census 2027: India’s First Digital Enumeration Exercise
topics.why_in_news: Government announced Census 2027 as India’s first fully digital census with caste enumeration and large-scale digital governance integration.
prelims_quick_notes: Census 2027 will be India’s first digital enumeration exercise.
Census is conducted decennially in India.
Census is a Union subject under Entry 69 of Union List.
Section 15 ensures confidentiality of census data.
Digital census uses mobile applications and self-enumeration systems.
Caste enumeration included beyond SC/ST categories.
CMMS portal introduced for real-time monitoring.
key_findings_and_indicators: Census Moment fixed at 00:00 hrs on March 1, 2027.
important_facts: Census is not covered under RTI due to confidentiality provisions.
Caste data expected to improve welfare targeting.
Digital Public Infrastructure integrated into census operations.
exam_relevance: Important for Governance, Society and Digital Administration.
Useful for demographic transition, welfare targeting and data governance topics.
Can be linked with federalism, privacy and evidence-based policymaking.
prelims_traps: Census is a Union subject, not State subject.
Section 15 ensures confidentiality of census information.
Census differs from NRC and population register exercises.
India’s first synchronous Census conducted in 1881.
